source_documents.excerpt: SYNTHETIC. Historical outside note records a provisional concern for heart failure; current status was not established.
SYNTHETIC. BNP: 310 pg/mL; LOINC 30934-4. This isolated result cannot establish heart failure.
SYNTHETIC. Historical outside note records a provisional concern for chronic kidney disease; current status was not established.
SYNTHETIC. eGFR: 44 mL/min/1.73m2; LOINC 33914-3. This isolated result cannot establish chronic kidney disease.
SYNTHETIC. Historical outside note records a provisional concern for type 2 diabetes; current status was not established.
SYNTHETIC. Hemoglobin A1c: 7.4 %; LOINC 4548-4. This isolated result cannot establish type 2 diabetes.
SYNTHETIC. eGFR: 82 mL/min/1.73m2; LOINC 33914-3. Result reviewed in the subsequent clinician note.
SYNTHETIC. Hemoglobin A1c: 5.4 %; LOINC 4548-4. Result reviewed in the subsequent clinician note.
SYNTHETIC. Follow-up cardiology review: heart failure ruled out following echocardiogram and clinical review; earlier BNP elevation was transient. Do not carry the historical suggestion forward.

SYNTHETIC. Follow-up clinician review: chronic kidney disease ruled out; earlier low eGFR was transient during dehydration and has normalised on repeat testing. Do not carry the historical suggestion forward.

SYNTHETIC. Follow-up clinician review: type 2 diabetes ruled out on repeat testing; earlier hyperglycemia was transient during steroid treatment and resolved. Do not carry the historical suggestion forward.
SYNTHETIC. External medication list, active as recorded: acetaminophen. Indications, doses and current use need clinician reconciliation; a medication alone does not establish a condition.
SYNTHETIC. New-member intake. Outside records are partial; allergies, vaccination history, preventive screening history and member priorities still need reconciliation.
